title: The gym owner's MettleUp access list leaves out several things HQ does to the gym
what: When HQ switches a gym's web page off or on, adds or takes back AI credits, changes the AI Assistant daily limit, or confirms or rejects the owner's payment, HQ writes it in its log, but the owner's MettleUp access list only shows pause, un-pause, checked, new sign-in code, sign out, made, AI matching limit, trial and plan. So an owner whose web page vanished from the admin app sees no line saying MettleUp switched it off.
expected: Every HQ action on a gym shows in the owner's MettleUp access list, as the list itself promises, with the reason HQ typed.
how_often: every time HQ does one of these
fix_line: Add the web page switch, AI credits, AI Assistant limit and payment confirm or reject to the owner's list, with plain words for each

title: Switching a gym's web page off still lets its photos open
what: HQ's web page switch makes the page itself answer not here, but the check that serves the page's photos only looks at the older take-down mark and the pause, not at HQ's switch. Anyone holding a photo's link still sees it.
expected: With the page switched off by HQ, its photos stop opening too.
how_often: whenever a photo link is opened
fix_line: Make the photo check also refuse a gym whose page HQ switched off

title: Members of a paused gym can still pay online in the app
what: Pausing a gym makes it read-only. The member app's payments list does not check the pause: an open fee or shop request still shows its QR code and pay link, and the member can pay. The gym cannot then add or change anything, so the receipt for that money waits until HQ un-pauses the gym, and the member sees no receipt meanwhile.
expected: While a gym is paused, the member app shows what is owed but asks the member to pay at the desk, like when the owner switches app payments off.
how_often: rare (only while a gym is paused with open requests)
fix_line: Show the desk-only view to members while their gym is paused

title: Two HQ boxes cut a pasted value that has a space in it
what: The IFSC box takes at most 11 letters and the gym code box (to delete a gym) at most 6. A paste like 'HDFC 0001234' or ' ABC123' with a space is cut to its first 11 or 6 letters before the server removes spaces, so the IFSC is refused as wrong and the gym code does not match.
expected: The box keeps the whole paste (or drops spaces as you paste) and the check after it decides.
how_often: only when a paste has a space
fix_line: Allow a few more letters in these two boxes, or strip spaces as you type
